archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp457.0: Follow the smoke to a burnt shack.
SCP-457: a tall, gaunt figure of charred, cracked skin that glows from within, with flames rising off its whole body. It hunts people and villagers.
Whatever it strikes catches fire, and its slow, heavy breathing carries a long way. What it kills does not stay down for long.
Containment requires sprinkler coverage. It keeps out of bad weather when it can. Its file in the Archive says more.

dossier.scp_unleashed.457.title: The Burning Man
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.caption: SCP-457 inside the burnt-out shack where it was found, seen from the doorway.
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.0.text.0: SCP-457 is held in a fireproof cell of bare stone and steel with a high ceiling. No wood, cloth or paper may be brought within twenty metres of it.
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.0.text.1: **Containment requires full sprinkler coverage of the cell at all times. The system is tested every day.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.0.text.2: Personnel entering the cell wear fire-resistant suits. Testing with D-class subjects is suspended. %rSee Incident 457-1.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.1.text.0: SCP-457 is a gaunt humanoid figure about two and a half metres tall, with long limbs and a small, featureless head. Its skin is charred black and flaking, split by cracks that glow like live coals, brightest at the joints and across the chest. Flames rise without pause from all over its body, thickest across the chest and shoulders. The body appears to be only the shape the fire keeps.
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.1.text.1: SCP-457 hunts any person it sees, villagers included, and ignores animals unless attacked. Anything it strikes catches fire. Its slow, heavy breathing can be heard well before it comes into view.
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.1.text.2: When SCP-457 kills a living thing, the flames left behind stand up as a second instance within seconds. Those later instances burn out for good once put out. The original does not. It slumps into a low heap of ash that is never quite cold.
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.2.title: Addendum 457-1: Recovery
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.2.text: SCP-457 was found in a burnt-out shack after reports of smoke over one patch of ground for days. A fire still burned in the hearth. SCP-457 stood under what was left of the roof and did not leave it while a storm passed overhead.
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.3.title: Incident 457-1
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.3.text: During a feeding test SCP-457 killed D-4419 inside the cell. A second instance rose from the remains within seconds. Both were contained once the sprinklers were triggered. Since then SCP-457 keeps well away from the cell drain, and steps back from staff carrying cleaning buckets. %rWhat remained of the second instance was logged as ash.%r
block.scp_unleashed.scp457_ash_pile.tool: A low heap of dark grey ash, still faintly warm.
The instances it raises burn out for good. The first one never quite does.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp457_ash_pile.1: The burnt remains of the first SCP-457. Its offshoots leave nothing behind when they go out, but this heap stays, and it is never quite cold.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp457_ash_pile.2: A shovel can scoop it up and carry it elsewhere. Its file in the Archive says more.
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.4.title: Incident 457-2
dossier.scp_unleashed.457.page.4.text: Months after the original instance was last put out, a welder repairing the cell door let sparks fall across its ash. Staff reported the heap glowing brighter by the second. %rThe cell was evacuated ninety seconds later.%r
